title: BowJil's Refreshed Tools
description: Refresh your tools with this Texture Pack!
body:
BowJil's Refreshed Tools is a resource pack that gives Minecrafts tools a brand new refreshed look with some unique changes.

This pack includes:

- Stone Tools with some missing parts to make them represent how literally nobody likes them

- Color-matching sticks that blend better with their tool color (for example iron sticks for iron tools)

- Lava-themed Netherite Tools, because regular netherite didn’t look cool enough

This is my first resource pack, so its a work in progress. I would really appreciate feedback to what I can make better.

I made this pack for fun, and I hope at least one person out there enjoys using it. :D
